sentences.en: Thirteen is a lucky number in the Brazilian Federal Lottery.
sentences.zh: 13在巴西联邦彩票中是个幸运数字。

sentences.en: My thirteen year old girl loves to watch romance movies.
sentences.zh: 我十三岁的女儿喜欢看浪漫电影。

sentences.en: I spent three months in hospital when I was thirteen.
sentences.zh: 在我十三岁的时候，我在医院住了三个月。

senses.zh: 十三的；十三个的形容词:thirteen
